admin/relays/remove.note: 受理済みリレーの 10 分キャッシュは isolate ごと。公開ノート・削除・Update(Person)（移行時を含む）・ピン留めの Add / Remove・投票の Update(Question) を LD 署名（RsaSignature2017、jsonld）付きでリレーへ配送し、リレー経由の受信も LD 署名で検証する
admin/relays/remove.noteEn: The 10-minute cache of accepted relays is per isolate. Public notes, deletions, Update(Person) (including on move), pin Add / Remove, and vote Update(Question) are delivered to relays with an LD signature (RsaSignature2017, jsonld), and reception via relays is also verified with an LD signature
